name: meta-ads-manager
description: Conversational Meta Ads Manager copilot for Kimi project chats: campaign status reports on demand, and guided campaign setup following Meta's framework (objective, budget, audience, placements, assets, tracking) with an execution recommendation before anything is created.

interface.shortDescription: Ask campaign status or set up campaigns conversationally
interface.longDescription: Connects to Meta's official Ads MCP server (Meta Business OAuth). Ask for campaign status and get a performance readout with recommendations. Ask to set up a campaign and Kimi interviews you following Meta's campaign setup framework, then returns an execution recommendation for your approval before creating anything (always PAUSED by default).
